exactMigrationOrderRecommended.step: Create a CRM/Admin facade contract without changing behavior.
exactMigrationOrderRecommended.why: Current social-app imports, state and session hooks need a stable boundary before any move.

exactMigrationOrderRecommended.step: Extract read-only CRM state/load facade for leads, customers and staff while keeping existing social routes active.
exactMigrationOrderRecommended.why: This isolates data loading without moving UI or event binding first.

exactMigrationOrderRecommended.step: Move lead/customer/staff render and event ownership behind the facade, still serving current routes.
exactMigrationOrderRecommended.why: Modal and button ids must remain exactly compatible before route rewrites change.

exactMigrationOrderRecommended.step: Move lead write operations after the facade proves it preserves restaurant/user/public-meta/count side effects.
exactMigrationOrderRecommended.why: Lead create/delete is the highest-risk write path.

exactMigrationOrderRecommended.step: Move lead-to-customer conversion as its own step.
exactMigrationOrderRecommended.why: Conversion bridges lead, customer, restaurant and user linkage and must be verified separately.
Customer saves can update restaurants and linked leads and should follow the lead contract.

exactMigrationOrderRecommended.step: Move CEO staff write/delete operations and location picker dependencies.
exactMigrationOrderRecommended.why: Staff operations require auth creation, superadmin/user sync, profile storage and coordinates.

exactMigrationOrderRecommended.step: Move business accounts only after deciding whether they belong to Heart/Admin or remain business-owner shell UI.
exactMigrationOrderRecommended.why: Business accounts are shell-runtime-owned and restaurant-owner scoped, not CEO CRM cluster-owned.

exactMigrationOrderRecommended.step: Change route ownership for /leads, /staff, /customers and /business-accounts to Heart/Admin or explicit aliases.
exactMigrationOrderRecommended.why: Route changes should happen after the moved code can load independently.

exactMigrationOrderRecommended.step: Remove remaining normal social startup imports for CRM after route ownership is confirmed.
exactMigrationOrderRecommended.why: Only then can normal Feed/Search/Map startup stop loading CRM safely.

rollbackStrategy: Keep all CRM route rewrites pointing to apps/menyra-social/index.html until Heart/Admin route parity is ready.
Move via facade modules so imports can be restored by reverting the facade caller change instead of rewriting feature logic.
Do not delete original social CRM modules during the first route move.
Keep modal DOM ids and state field names stable during migration.
If a route move fails, revert the route rewrite and facade caller commit while leaving code inventory untouched.
Rollback command for this audit commit only is git revert <commit-hash>.

statusByArea.reason: Lead create/delete is coupled to restaurants, users, public meta, location fields and CRM counts.
Customer save has linked lead behavior and restaurant/public-meta writes.
Staff save/delete spans superadmins, users, profile storage and coordinates.
Business accounts are business-owner and shell-runtime scoped; ownership must be decided before migration.
User requested inventory only and no visible UI/product changes.
